explication: Screego is a low-latency, multi-user screen-sharing server. A user opens the web UI, authenticates if needed, creates or joins a room, and exchanges WebRTC offers, answers, and ICE candidates through the server’s WebSocket signaling layer. Media then flows peer-to-peer, optionally through TURN. The sampled files clearly show HTTP routing, authentication, WebSocket transport, client negotiation, and TURN setup; room orchestration and some event wiring are represented only where supported by the tree or excerpts.
